llm.summary: This is a markdown-only inventory planning skill, and the scanner warnings trace to formula notation and one stray invisible character rather than unsafe behavior.

dimensions.detail: The requested business inputs are proportionate to inventory planning and appear user-supplied; there is no broad local indexing, credential access, session/profile use, or unrelated data collection.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown skill, reference, and checklist files only; I found no executable scripts, dependency manifests, install hooks, remote URLs, or runtime payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It asks for sales, supplier, inventory, and cash-flow assumptions and can recommend ordering inventory, but it does not place orders or mutate any account data itself.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: I found no instructions to write memory, create background workers, install services, alter tools, escalate privileges, or persist behavior across sessions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to calculate ecommerce reorder timing, reorder quantities, safety stock, and risk tradeoffs; the inspected artifacts consistently provide formulas, checklists, and output templates for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the generated reorder recommendations before acting because they can affect purchasing and cash flow. From a security perspective, the skill is a static markdown guide with no executable install behavior; the only cleanup worth considering is removing the stray zero-width character for readability.
llm.findings:
[P2] unexpected: Verified a single U+200B zero-width space in references/safety-stock-guide.md inside the phrase about weekly sigma; it is not an instruction, directive, credential, or behavior-changing payload.
[AE4] expected: The Unicode content across the markdown files is formula and formatting notation such as sigma, square root, multiplication, arrows, check marks, and punctuation, which fits the inventory-calculation purpose; I found no obfuscated commands or hidden security-relevant instructions.
